# Test fixtures

Payloads the unit tests decode, so a change in the API's shape shows up as a
failing test with a readable diff rather than as a surprise in production.

| Directory | Contents | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `responses/` | Successful response bodies | Assembled from the examples in the API's OpenAPI schema (`https://api.typesafe.ai/openapi.json`) |
| `errors/` | Error response bodies | Likewise, from the schema's `HTTPValidationError` example |
| `requests/` | Golden request encodings | Generated by this SDK; refresh with `go test -run TestRequestGolden -update` |
| `live/` | Bodies captured from the live API | Written by `go test -tags integration -run TestIntegrationRecord -record`; absent until someone records them |

The schema examples document the shape the API promises. The live captures are
what it actually sends. When both exist the tests decode both, and a live
capture that stops decoding is the API telling you its shape changed: refresh
it and read the diff.
